Stander has quickly become a leader in innovative products that enhance mobility and extend independence. With a dedicated research and development team, the company is committed to further expanding its line to meet the growing needs of customers. Tools that answer real life needs are the hallmark of this company. Parentgiving is pleased to offer Stander mobility aids that make everyday life easier and more comfortable — at affordable prices. For many, daily tasks such as getting out of bed, standing up from the toilet or getting up out of a chair can be difficult. It's our goal to provide you and your loved ones with quality products that help you to feel safe and allow you to live your life to the fullest. Included is a wide range of in-home designs that offer support for getting in and out of bed and chairs, from bed rails and poles to organizers and standing aids that also hold personal items you need within reach. For those who have an active lifestyle, Stander also makes effective mobility items, such as its easy-to-fold walkers and car aids that offer support and easier seating.

Adjustable bed rails are the perfect solution to bedroom mobility, as they can be adjusted either up or down or width-wise to suit a person's particular needs in relation to their size and other considerations and also can be minimized almost completely when not needed.

Adult Bed Rails are a great support tool for when getting in and out of bed is a challenge. Often family caregivers call us looking for support structures like hospital beds, when in reality, a good bed rail can serve a similar purpose at a fraction of the cost. A lack of upper body strength, poor mobility and balance issues are some factors that can make this activity of daily living difficult and even painful. One of the simplest yet most effective solutions is a supportive bed rail. Quickly installed, a rail offers one or more easily accessible grasping points to ease lying down and standing up from bed and adjusting position while in bed. Some styles pivot or fold down and out of the way, while others also come with holders for bedside essentials like reading glasses. The following are our Parentgiving Picks for best Adult Bed Rails:

products.title: Bed Rail Advantage Traveler by Stander

description.html: Even away from home you can rest safely and get out of bed easily with the most portable bed rail ever designed. The Advantage Traveler comes fully assembled and weighs less than 8 pounds. To use, simply unfold the Traveler and slide it between the box spring and mattress. A safety strap is included for extra security. The Traveler features a cushion grip handle and bonus organizer pouch. Features: Prevent Falls: The ergonomic and padded handle of the Advantage Traveler helps to provide balance and support when transferring from bed Bariatric Support: The heavy duty Bed Rail Advantage Traveler supports up to 400 lbs making it the perfect bariatric solution for bedroom fall prevention Folds for Storage: Remove the two pins and fold the bed rail in half to carry on vacation in a suitcase or to keep in storage for visiting parents Organizer Pouch: Store small items in an easily accessible location next to your bed inside the included storage pouch Easy to Install: The Advantage Traveler slips between the mattress and box spring/slats and attaches to the bedframe with the included safety strap Bed Compatibility: The Bed Rail Advantage Traveler works with most traditional bed types with mattresses between 6″ and 16″ thick. Use the rail with any mattress size from a Twin to a California King. It is not intended to be used with adjustable beds. Do not use with an extra soft mattress

products.title: No Gap Deluxe Half Length Side Bed Rails by Drive Medical

description.html: A unique design saves you from worry on this no-gap deluxe half length side bed rail by Drive Medical. It prevents individuals from being lodged between bars. The 1 inch steel construction with brown vein finish is durable and strong yet attractive. The rail fits most hospital beds with a steel frame (it is advisable to confirm compatibility with the bed manufacturer prior to purchase) and is ideal for maximum protection with the bed elevated. It comes easy to install and protected by a manufacturers limited lifetime warranty. (Not for use with Pan-Style bed surfaces.) 36" Long x 18" High x 2" Wide. Please Note: Comes as 1 pair of two half length bed rails.
